projects.title: Projects

deployment.empty_text: Press Deploy to pull the image and start the service.
deployment.failed_next: Fix the cause, then press Deploy again. The old release keeps running if there was one.
deployment.detail.ssh_key: This repository has an SSH address. Make a deploy key in the settings of the service, add it to the repository, then deploy again.

deployment.reason.image_pull_failed: The image could not be pulled. Check the image name and tag.
deployment.reason.container_start_failed: The container did not start. Check the logs.
deployment.reason.health_check_failed: The health check failed. Check the port and the logs.
deployment.reason.node_unavailable: No node is ready. Add a node or check the node state.
logs.label: Service log
logs.empty: No logs yet. Logs appear when the service writes output.
domains.caption: Domains
domains.host_hint: For example app.example.com. No http:// and no path.
domains.host_invalid: Enter a domain name like app.example.com.
domains.port_hint: The port inside the container. Leave empty to use the port of the service.
domains.https_hint: The server gets a free certificate for the domain.
domains.tls_pending: Waiting for the DNS record and the certificate. Create the DNS record below first.
domains.dns_hint: Create these records at your DNS provider:
domains.dns_no_ip: No node has a public IP yet. Add a node first, then create the DNS record for it.
domains.empty_text: A domain makes the service reachable at your own address, with HTTPS. Add one.

domains.nodes_failed: The node list did not load.
domains.nodes_failed_next: The DNS records may be incomplete. Reload the page.
nodes.title: Nodes
nodes.caption: Nodes
nodes.name: Name
nodes.labels_hint: One label per line, like region=eu.
nodes.labels_invalid: Write each label as key=value, one per line.
nodes.name_required: Enter a name for the node.
nodes.run_command: Run this command as root on the new server:
nodes.shown_once: This command is shown only once. Copy it now.
nodes.help_title: The node did not connect yet.
nodes.help_port: Check that the server can reach the control port.
nodes.help_firewall: Check the firewall of both servers.
nodes.help_clock: Check that the clock of the new server is right.
nodes.empty_text: Only the control-plane server is here. Add a server to run services on more machines.

wizard.source.git_text: Build from a repository with Railpack or a Dockerfile.
wizard.source.image_text: Run a ready image from a registry, also a private one.
wizard.connection_hint: Pick a connection for a private repository.
wizard.connection_admin_only: Only an admin can use Git connections. You can use a public repository URL.
wizard.use_compose: Use a Docker Compose file of this repository
wizard.use_compose_hint: Several services of the repository are made from one docker-compose.yml. A service with build: is built from the repository.
wizard.branch_invalid: Enter a branch name without spaces.
wizard.registry_login_hint: The login is saved as a secret. It is never shown again.
wizard.advanced_phone: Replicas and resources use the defaults. Change them later on a larger screen.
wizard.domain_hint: For example app.example.com. You can add it later too.
wizard.variables_hint: Paste .env text into a name field to add many rows. Mark secret values as secret.
wizard.deploy_now_hint: Starts the first build or pull at once.
wizard.partly_created: The service was created, but a later step failed. Press Create service again to retry only the missing steps.
git.name: Name
git.name_required: Enter a name for the connection.
settings.compose_link: Import the docker-compose.yml of this repository
settings.builder_hint: Railpack finds the language by itself. Dockerfile uses your own file.
settings.build_path_hint: The folder in the repository to build. / is the root.
settings.command_hint: Replaces the command of the image. Use quotes for words with spaces.
settings.replicas_hint: How many containers run. Applies without a new build.
settings.replicas_invalid: Use a whole number from 0 to 100.
settings.managed: Managed by polipan.yaml. Change it in the file.
settings.next_deploy: Changes apply with the next deploy.
settings.saved: Saved. Deploy to apply the changes.
settings.read_only: Your role can read the settings, but not change them.
variables.intro: Values of the project and the environment apply too. The most specific scope wins.
variables.caption: Variables and secrets
variables.empty_text: Variables and secrets are given to the service as environment variables. Add the first one.
variables.name: Name
variables.name_hint: Letters, numbers and _. It cannot start with a number.
variables.name_invalid: Use letters, numbers and _, up to 128 characters. Do not start with a number.
variables.name_reserved: Names that start with POLIPAN_ are set by Polipan.
variables.build_time_hint: The build can read it. Off by default.
variables.preview_hint: Preview environments get only values with this flag.
variables.name_conflict: This name already exists as a variable or a secret in this scope.
variables.reference_cycle: The values read each other in a circle. Remove one of the ${{...}} references.
variables.unresolved_reference: A ${{...}} reference points to a name that does not exist.
variables.managed_by_git: This is managed by polipan.yaml. Change it in the file.
variables.delete_text: The service keeps the old value until the next deploy.
secret.write_only: Write-only. The value is never shown after save.
secret.never_shown: Secrets are never shown after save.
secret.delete_text: Releases that use it keep their version until it is destroyed. The service keeps it until the next deploy.
import.title: Import variables
import.text_hint: One NAME=value per line, or a JSON object. The text is not kept after reading.
import.parse_failed: This is not .env text or a JSON object.
where_used.title: Where {name} is used
where_used.hint: The last 10 releases of each service in this environment.
where_used.none: No release used this name yet.
versions.title: Versions of {name}
versions.hint: Values are never shown. Restore makes a new version from an old one.
versions.used_reason: Used by {count} kept releases. It cannot be destroyed.
versions.destroy_text: The encrypted value of this version is deleted for good. A rollback to a release that uses it is no longer possible.
storage.caption: Volumes
storage.empty_text: A volume keeps data when the service is deployed again. Add one for files that must stay.
storage.name: Name
storage.kind.volume_hint: A Docker volume on the node. The default.
storage.kind.bind_hint: A folder under /var/lib/polipan/binds on the node.
storage.kind.tmpfs_hint: In memory. The data is lost on restart.
storage.path_hint: The path inside the container, for example /data.
storage.path_invalid: Enter a path that starts with / and has no spaces.
storage.access_mode_hint: Single writer means one container at a time, so deploys may have a short downtime.
storage.size_hint: An alert limit, or a hard limit where the disk supports it.
storage.applies_next_deploy: The change applies with the next deploy.
storage.delete_text: The volume is removed from the service. The data stays as an orphan volume, unless you check the box below.
storage.files_hint: Small config files, up to 1 MB, mounted read-only. Not for secrets.
storage.file_too_big: The file is larger than 1 MB.
storage.remove_file_text: The file is removed with the next deploy.
storage.orphans_hint: Volumes of deleted services. Their data still uses disk space.
storage.orphan_delete_text: The volume and all its data are deleted for good.

terminal.input_hint: Press Enter to send the line.

deployments.title: Deployments
deployments.empty_text: Open a service and press Deploy. Its deployments show up here.
deployment.cancel_text: The deployment stops. The release that runs now keeps running.
deployment.cancel_not_now: Cancel is not possible now. Wait until it ends, then roll back.
deployment.rolled_back_next: The old release is live again. Fix the cause, then deploy again.
deployment.cancelled_next: The release that was live before keeps running.
deployment.superseded_title: A newer deployment replaced this one.
deployment.superseded_next: Open the newest deployment of this service to see what runs.
deployment.live_next: Something wrong? You can roll back to the last release for 10 minutes.
deployment.reason.build_failed: The build failed. Open the build log.
deployment.reason.build_timeout: The build took too long and was stopped.
deployment.reason.pre_deploy_failed: The pre-deploy command failed. Open the build log.
deployment.reason.health_timeout: The new containers did not become healthy in time. Check the health check and the logs.
deployment.reason.health_failed: The health check failed. Check the port and the logs.
deployment.reason.gate_5xx: Too many server errors. Traffic went back to the old release.
deployment.reason.gate_latency: The service was too slow. Traffic went back to the old release.
deployment.reason.switch_failed: The traffic switch failed. The old release keeps running.
deployment.reason.internal_error: An internal error happened. Check the server logs.
deploy.title: Deploy {service}
deploy.protected: Production. Protected environment: only an admin can deploy here.
deploy.plan_failed: The plan could not be made.
deploy.strategy_value.recreate: Recreate (stop the old, then start the new)
deploy.forced: The strategy was changed for this service.
deploy.no_cache_hint: Slower, but it ignores old build layers.
plan.warning.zero_downtime_not_available: Zero downtime is not available for this service. It will be stopped and started again.
plan.warning.migration_compat: A pre-deploy command runs while the old release still serves traffic. Make sure the migration works with the old and the new code.
plan.warning.domain_port_mismatch: A domain points to a port that the service does not use. Check the domain settings.
service.no_previous: There is no earlier release to roll back to.
service.unhealthy_title: A container of this service is unhealthy.
rollback.title: Roll back {service} to v{number}
rollback.text: This starts v{number} again. The release that is live now stays available.
rollback.rebuild: No stopped containers are left. The image is pulled again, so it takes longer.
rollback.pruned_text: This release cannot start again. Deploy from its commit instead.
rollback.pruned_reason: Image was removed. Deploy from commit instead.
rollback.restored_list: Image, config, variables and secret versions.
rollback.not_restored_list: Data in volumes and database content.
rollback.error.release_image_pruned: The image of this release was removed. Deploy from its commit instead.
rollback.error.secret_version_destroyed: A secret version of this release was destroyed, so it cannot start again.
rollback.error.deploy_running: A deployment is running. Wait until it ends.
releases.empty_text: A release is made by each deploy. Deploy the service to create the first one.
releases.caption: Releases
releases.author: Created by
releases.note_hint: A short text to find this release later.
diff.title: Compare {a} and {b}
diff.empty_text: These two releases have the same image, config, variables and secret versions.
diff.secrets_note: Secret values are never shown. Only version numbers are compared.
diff.caption: Differences between two releases
health.type_hint: HTTP asks a path. TCP opens the port. Command runs a command in the container.
health.path_hint: For example /healthz. A status from 200 to 399 is healthy.
health.command_hint: Runs in the container. Exit code 0 is healthy.
health.port_hint: Optional. The port of the service is used when this is empty.
health.number_invalid: Use a whole number of 1 or more.
health.restart_hint: Restart a container that stays unhealthy.
health.test_text: Runs the check once against a live container. It does not change anything.
settings.strategy_hint: Blue-green starts the new release before the switch. Recreate stops the old one first.
settings.drain_hint: How long the old release keeps running after the switch. Default: 30.
settings.drain_invalid: Use a whole number of 0 or more.
settings.allow_downtime: Allow downtime when capacity is low
settings.allow_downtime_hint: If the node cannot run both releases, stop the old one first.
settings.allow_overlap: Allow old and new to run together
settings.allow_overlap_hint: Turn this off for a worker that must never run twice.
settings.pre_deploy_hint: Runs once before the switch, for example a migration.
settings.post_deploy_hint: Runs once after the new release is live.
settings.migration_warning: The old release serves traffic while this command runs. A migration must work with the old and the new code. A rollback does not undo it.
onboarding.title: Get started
onboarding.text: Four steps to your first running service. You can skip a step and come back later.
onboarding.load_failed: The setup steps could not be loaded.
onboarding.step.org_text: The name shows at the top of every page.
onboarding.step.server_text: Optional. The control-plane server can already run services.
onboarding.step.domain_text: Point a domain to a service. Polipan checks the DNS for you.
onboarding.step.service_text: Run an app from a Git repository or a container image.
wizard.source.template_text: Start from a ready recipe such as WordPress with MySQL.
wizard.source.database_text: A managed database: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, MongoDB or Redis.
wizard.source.compose_text: Read a Docker Compose file from a Git repository, or paste it. Polipan converts it to services and builds the ones with build: from the repository.
backup.delete_text: The schedule stops. The snapshots stay on the targets and can be read with restic.
backup.page_intro: Every backup policy of the organization and its restore check.
backup.local_warning: Stored on the server only. Add a remote target to be safe.
backup.no_targets: There is no backup target yet. Add one first.
backup.overdue_text: No restore check passed in twice the check interval. A backup that was never restored is not safe. Run a check now.
backup.no_checks: No restore check yet. One runs after the first good backup.
backup.schedule_hint: A cron expression in UTC, for example 0 2 * * * for every day at 02:00.
backup.cron_invalid: Use a cron expression with five fields.
backup.retention_hint: Older snapshots are removed after each good run. A rule with 0 is not used.
backup.retention_invalid: Use whole numbers from 0, with at least one above 0.
backup.check_enabled_hint: Polipan restores the latest snapshot into a temporary container and tests it.
backup.check_mode_hint: Sample reads only a part of the data. Use it for very large data.
backup.hooks: Commands before and after the backup
backup.hook_hint: One command per line. They run in the container.
backup.volume_required: Pick the volume to back up.
backup.empty_text: No backup yet. Add a policy and a target.
backup.suggestion_text: Add a daily backup with the suggested settings, or skip it. Skipping is recorded.
backup.skipped_text: You skipped the backup of this database. It has no backup.
restore.title: Restore {name}
restore.no_snapshot: Pick a target with a snapshot.
restore.mode.new_service_text: Makes a copy with its own password. The original is not changed. Use it to look at the data.
restore.mode.in_place_text: Replaces the current data. There is a short downtime.
restore.summary_new: A new database service {name} is created and the snapshot is loaded into it.
restore.downtime_db: Open connections are closed while the data is replaced. Apps that use the database fail for a short time.
restore.downtime_files: The service is stopped while the files are replaced, then started again.
restore.safety: A safety backup of the current data is made first. If it fails, nothing is restored.
restore.running: The restore is running. You can close this window.
restore.done_new: The data is in the new service {name}.
target.title: Backup targets
target.intro: Where backups are stored. Keys are write-only: they are never shown again. All data is encrypted by restic before it leaves the node.
target.caption: Backup targets
target.empty_text: Add S3, SFTP or another place to store backups.
target.name: Name
target.name_invalid: Use 1 to 63 letters, digits, spaces or . _ -
target.secret_keep: Leave empty to keep the stored value. It is never shown.
target.delete_text: A target that a policy uses cannot be deleted. The data on the target is not touched.
target.endpoint_hint: Leave empty for Amazon S3. For MinIO and others, for example https://minio.example.com.
target.path_hint: Optional. Every policy gets its own folder inside.
target.known_host_hint: Optional. Without it the key is trusted on first use.
target.local_hint: A folder under /var/lib/polipan/backups on the node.
template.title: Catalog
template.intro: Ready recipes. A template makes all its services in one step, or none.
template.empty_text: No template matches. Try another word or import a Compose file.
template.import_compose: Import a Compose file in a project
template.custom_hint: It must pass the safety check: no privileged mode, no host network, no Docker socket.
template.create_failed: The services were not created. Nothing was changed.
template.conflict: A name or a domain is already used. Nothing was created.
template.all_or_nothing: All services are created together. If one fails, none is created.
template.domain_hint: DNS does not need to work yet. HTTPS starts when it does.
template.secret_generated: Leave empty and Polipan makes a random value. It is never shown.
database.version_hint: A new major version later is a manual step: dump and restore into a new service.
database.review_volume: One volume named data, one writer.
database.review_password: A random 32 character password is made and stored as a secret. It is never shown.
database.review_private: No port is open to the internet. Only services of the same environment can connect.
database.review_recreate: Deploys stop the old container first (recreate): there is a short downtime.
database.created_text: The password is a secret and is not shown. Other services read it through a reference.
database.reference_hint: Put the reference in a variable of the other service. It resolves at the next release.
compose.label: Docker Compose file
compose.hint: Supported: image, command, environment, ports, named volumes, depends_on, healthcheck, restart and resource limits. Other keys are listed and ignored. build: is not supported: use a Git service.
compose.problems_title: These parts of the file cannot be imported
compose.safe_tip: Polipan keeps your server safe: no folders of the server and no Docker socket. Images, ports, environment, named volumes and health checks work.
compose.problem.bind: the folder {path} is on the server and cannot be mounted. Use a named volume, or build the code from Git.
compose.problem.socket: the Docker socket cannot be mounted. This is not allowed for safety. Remove this volume or this service.
compose.repo_hint: A full https address, for example https://github.com/acme/shop.git
compose.file_hint: The path of the file. A service with build: is built from this repository.
compose.skip_unsafe_hint: A service that mounts the Docker socket, and the folders of the server, are left out. Each one is listed.
compose.variables: Variables of the file (NAME=value, one per line)
compose.variables_hint: Values for the names that the file reads, for example DB_DATABASE=app. A name without a value stays empty.
delete.title: Delete this service
delete.text: The service stops and its containers are removed. Its data stays in its volumes unless you choose to delete it.
delete.group: Delete the whole template group ({count} services)
delete.final_backup_hint: Runs the backup policy now. If it fails, nothing is deleted.
delete.no_backup: This database has no backup policy. After the delete its data is only in its volume.
delete.volumes_hint: This cannot be undone. Without it the data stays on the node as an orphan volume.
delete.backup_timeout: The final backup did not end in 30 minutes.
terminal.db_client: Start the database client after the shell opens:
sso.title: Single sign-on
sso.intro: Let people sign in with Google, GitHub or your own OpenID Connect provider. Map the groups of the provider to roles.
sso.required_hint: Passwords stop working for everybody. Owners can still use a password with two-factor login (break-glass), if the organization allows it.
sso.required_needs_provider: Add and enable a provider first.
sso.required_confirm: Everybody except owners must sign in with the identity provider. Test the login first, or you may lock people out. Owners keep a password login with two-factor (break-glass), and every such login is written to the audit log.
sso.break_glass_note: Break-glass: with SSO required, an owner can still log in with a password and a two-factor code. This is audited as auth.break_glass.
sso.phone: SSO can be changed on a laptop. Here you can only read it.
sso.empty_text: Add one to show a sign-in button on the login page.
sso.pick: Choose a provider or add one.
sso.mappings_hint: Applied on every login. A mapped role is replaced at the next login. Roles set by hand stay. The highest role wins.
sso.group_hint: The value of the groups claim.
sso.unsafe: With a default role and automatic user creation, anybody with a Google or GitHub account would get access. Add an allowed domain first.
sso.name: Name (shown on the login button)
sso.issuer_hint: The address that has /.well-known/openid-configuration. It must use https.
sso.scopes_hint: Separated by spaces. Empty means the default for the type.
sso.groups_claim_hint: The name of the claim with the groups, for example groups.
sso.domains_hint: Separated by commas. Empty means any domain.
sso.domains_hint_google: Separated by commas. Google also checks the hosted domain (hd) of the account.
sso.default_role_hint: For users that no mapping gives a role.
sso.auto_create_hint: Without it, only people who already have an account can sign in.
sso.callback_url: Redirect address (set it in the provider)
sso.test_login_hint: Signs in at the provider and comes back here. Nothing is created.
sso.delete_text: People who sign in with {name} can no longer do it. Their accounts stay.
login.sso_error.bad_state: The login took too long or was started in another browser. Try again.
login.sso_error.email_not_verified: The provider did not confirm your email address.
login.sso_error.domain_not_allowed: Your email domain is not allowed.
login.sso_error.no_account: There is no account for you. Ask an admin.
login.sso_error.no_access: You have no access. Ask an admin to map your group to a role.
login.sso_error.unsafe_config: This provider is not set up safely. Ask an admin.
login.sso_error.provider_error: The provider did not answer or refused the login.
login.totp_needed: This account uses two-factor sign-in. Enter your code.
login.totp_hint: The 6-digit code from your app, or a recovery code.

forgot.text: Polipan has no mail sender. Ask an admin to run this command on the server:
forgot.next: The admin gives you a link. Open it to set a new password.

reset.no_token: Open the link that the admin gave you.

invite.intro: You were invited. Choose your name and a password.
invite.no_token: Open the full link of the invitation.

members.caption: Members and invitations
members.invite_done: The invitation for {email} is ready. Send this link to the person.
members.invite_once: The link is shown only once. Polipan sends no email.
members.remove_text: {email} loses access. Sessions and tokens are revoked.
members.cancel_invite_text: The invitation for {email} will stop working.
members.admin_owner: An admin cannot change an owner.
members.last_owner: An organization needs at least one owner. Make someone else an owner first.

teams.name: Team name

teams.empty_text: Teams give the same project role to many people.

roles.choose_first: Choose a user or team first.

tokens.name: Name
tokens.project_hint: Limit the token to one project.
tokens.expires_hint: Optional. Empty means it does not expire.
tokens.revoke_text: The token {name} stops working at once.
tokens.shown_once: This is the only time you see the full token.
tokens.show_all: Show the tokens of all users
tokens.caption: API tokens
tokens.empty_text: Create a token for a script or a CI job.
audit.title: Audit log
audit.caption: Audit events
audit.empty_text: No audit event matches these filters.
audit.verify_bad: The first broken entry is number {seq}.
twofa.title: Two-factor sign-in
twofa.off_text: Add a code from an app to your sign-in.
twofa.required: Your organization requires 2FA. Turn it on to continue.
twofa.scan_text: Add this key to your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.
twofa.recovery_text: Save these codes now. Each works once. You see them only now.
config.title: Config as code
config.intro: A polipan.yaml file in Git can describe this project. Plan shows what would change. Apply makes the change.
config.pending_title: A change from Git waits for an admin.
config.pending_admin: Plan the file below, check the changes, then apply it.
config.pending_other: Ask an admin to apply it.
config.drifted_title: Some fields differ from the file.
config.drifted_text: A field was changed by hand. Plan the file to see the list.
config.failed_text: Plan the file again. The errors show the line and the field.
config.source_admin_only: Only an admin can change the config source.
config.source_forbidden: You cannot change the config source. Ask an admin.
config.source_failed: The config source was not saved.
config.export_failed: The file could not be loaded.
config.file_hint: Paste the file, or load the current state of the project.
config.apply_text: This applies {count} changes to the project. Check the plan first.
config.apply_denied: You can plan, but you cannot apply. Ask a developer or an admin.
config.applied: The plan is applied. Deployments started for the changed services.
config.plan_changed: The project changed after the plan. Plan again.
config.plan_empty: No changes. The project matches the file.
config.unmanaged_note: This is not in the file. It is kept unless you choose to remove it.
config.prune_title: Resources that are not in the file
config.prune: Delete resources that are not in the file
config.prune_hint: Admin only. They are removed on apply.
config.prune_data_hint: Data is lost and cannot be restored.
move.title: Move {name} to another node
move.not_in_names: not in the allowed node names
move.no_downtime: The service starts on the new node first. Traffic switches when it is healthy, then the old container stops. No request fails.
move.data_title: The data is copied. The service stops for a short time.
move.data_text: This service has data on a volume. It stops, the volume is saved with a backup, restored on the new node and the service starts there.
move.data_backup: The volume needs a backup policy with a target. The old volume stays on the old node until you delete it.
nodes.waiting: Waiting for the server to connect…
nodes.reason_cordon: Only a ready node can be cordoned.
nodes.reason_drain: Only a ready or cordoned node can be drained.
nodes.reason_maintenance: Cordon or drain the node first.
nodes.draining_text: The services move to other nodes. The node goes to maintenance when it is empty.
nodes.self_check_hint: Tests Docker, Caddy and WireGuard on the node.
nodes.no_workloads_text: No service runs on this node.
nodes.drain_text: Every service on {name} moves to another node with a blue-green move. A service with a volume stops while its data is copied. The node ends in maintenance.
nodes.delete_text: The node is removed and its certificate is revoked. The agent on the server stops working.
nodes.delete_text_force: The node runs {count} workloads. They are lost. Services with failover auto start on other nodes, the others stop. The certificate is revoked.
nodes.orphans_hint: Volumes of services that are gone. Delete them to free disk space.
nodes.orphan_delete_text: The data of the volume {name} is deleted for good.
nodes.history_needs_audit: The history is read from the audit log. It needs the role admin or owner.
nodes.history_empty_text: Moves, drains and failovers show up here.
placement.title: Placement and failover
placement.nodes_hint: Node names, separated by commas. Empty means any node.
placement.labels_hint: One label per line, like zone=eu. A node needs all of them.
placement.spread_hint: With more than one replica, each replica goes to the node with the fewest copies of this service.
failover.policy_hint: Automatic failover starts the service on another node 60 s after the node is down.
failover.allow_loss_hint: A service with a volume restarts from the last backup. Data since that backup is lost.
failover.blocked_title: Failover did not move this service
failover.moving_text: The service starts on another node.
failover.moved_title: The service was moved after a failover
failover.moved_text: It runs on another node now.
failover.data_lost: Data since the last backup is lost. The backup is from
logs.reconnecting_text: The live stream is down. The lines stay here. It connects again by itself.
logs.gap: Gap of {seconds} s, logs are in search
logs.announce_toggle: Announce new lines to a screen reader
logs.nothing_to_download: There are no lines to download.
logs.keys: Keys: j and k move between lines, Space pauses or follows, c copies the line, / goes to the filter, Enter and Shift+Enter go to the next and the previous match.
logs.pending_table: {count} new lines wait. Switch to the list to see them.
logsearch.title: Logs search
logsearch.text_hint: A word, a phrase in quotes, or /regex/.
logsearch.beyond: Logs are kept for {days} days. Pick a later start.
logsearch.context_hint: Lines before and after each match, 0 to 20.
logsearch.none: Nothing found in this range. Widen the time range.
logsearch.context_text: This shows one minute before and after the line you picked.
metrics.step_hint: A chart has fewer than {count} points.
metrics.range_order: The start must be before the end.
metrics.beyond_retention: Metrics are kept for {days} days. Pick a later start.
metrics.unavailable_next: The metrics store does not answer. Logs and deployments still work. Check the monitoring component and try again.
metrics.no_data: No data yet. Metrics appear after the first scrape, every 15 seconds.
chart.keys: {title}. Use the left and right arrow keys to read each point.
chart.too_many: Only the first {count} series are drawn.
alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.no_channel_title: Some alert rules have no channel
alerts.no_channel_text: These rules send to nobody: {names}. Add a channel and pick it in the rule.
alerts.channel_failing_text: The last message did not arrive.
alerts.quiet_text: No alert is firing now. Polipan tells you here and in your channels when something needs you.
alerts.no_rules: There are no alert rules yet.
mute.title: Mute {name}
mute.text: No message is sent for this rule until the time ends. The alert stays in the list. The mute is written to the audit log.
alerts.read_only: Only an admin can change channels and rules. You can read them here.
alerts.phone_read_only: On a phone this page is read-only. Use a larger screen to change channels and rules.
alerts.no_channels: There are no channels yet. Add one so alerts can reach you.
alerts.name: Name
alerts.err_recipients: Enter at least one email address.
alerts.err_url: Enter a URL that starts with http:// or https://.
alerts.err_scope: Pick the target of the scope.
alerts.repeat_hint: How often a reminder is sent while the alert fires.
alerts.no_channel_warning: With no channel this rule sends to nobody.
alerts.delete_text: {name} will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
canary.title: Canary
canary.no_gate: No gate result yet. It comes at the end of the first step.
canary.reason.gate_latency: The new release is too slow
canary.abort_text: All traffic goes back to the old release at once. The new release is rolled back.
canary.options_hint: Traffic moves to the new release in steps. A step passes when the gate passes.
canary.p95_ratio_label: Highest p95 compared to the old release (times)
canary.err_steps: Enter whole percents from 1 to 100, from small to large, for example 10, 25, 50, 100.
canary.err_interval: Enter a whole number of seconds, 1 or more.
org.title: Organization
org.retention_text: How many days metrics and logs are kept. Older data is deleted.
org.days_invalid: Enter a whole number of days from 1 to {max}.
org.read_only: Only an admin can change these settings.
org.shrink_text: A shorter retention deletes data that is older than the new limit (metrics: {metrics} days, logs: {logs} days). This cannot be undone.
org.preview_domain_hint: A preview gets a URL under this domain. Example: preview.example.com.
deployall.title: Deploy services
deployall.text: Pick the services. Databases and images start first, services built from Git last.
promote.include_databases_hint: Databases are skipped by default, so no data is touched.
promote.no_targets: There is no other environment to promote to. Create one first.
promote.blocked_missing: Set the missing variables in the target first.
promote.missing_text: The target has no value for these variables. Set them in the target, then check again.
promote.no_changes: No changes. The target has this release already.
promote.plan_changed_text: The plan changed while you looked at it. The new plan is shown. Check it, then confirm again.
promote.error.missing_variables: Variables are missing in the target.
promote.error.release_not_promotable: This release cannot be promoted. Its image may be gone or the build did not finish.
promote.error.domain_port_mismatch: A domain of the source uses a port that the target does not have.
promote.error.forbidden: Only an admin can promote to a protected environment.
promote.partial: Not all services started. Open the failed deployment to see why, then promote again.
previews.title: Previews
previews.no_project_text: Create a project first. Then you can turn on previews for it.
previews.empty_text: No previews. Open a pull request or create one by hand.
previews.caption: Previews of the project
previews.repo_hint: Owner and name, for example acme/shop.
previews.base_default: The base of the project settings
previews.base_hint: The preview starts as a copy of this environment.
previews.fill_first: Fill in the repository and the number.
previews.delete_text: This deletes the preview environment, its services and its data.
previews.enabled_hint: Each pull request gets its own environment.
previews.grace_minutes: Minutes to keep after the PR closes
previews.grace_hint: The preview is deleted after this time. A reopened PR within this time brings it back.
previews.from_forks_hint: Code from a fork can run on your servers. Turn this on only if you trust forks.
previews.from_forks_admin: Only an admin can change this.
previews.node_selector_hint: One label per line, like key=value. Previews run on nodes with these labels.
previews.selector_invalid: Each line needs the form key=value.
previews.seed_hint: A command that runs once after the preview starts. Words are split by spaces.
previews.read_only: You can read these settings. Only a developer or an admin can change them.
previews.no_services: This preview has no services yet.
previews.failed_text: Check that every secret the services need is marked for previews, then deploy again.
previews.waiting_label: A maintainer must add the label polipan-preview to build the new commit.
git.title: Git connections
git.intro: Connect GitHub, GitLab, Gitea or another Git server. Services use a connection to read code and get push events.
git.empty_text: Add a connection to deploy from a private repository.
git.caption: Git connections
git.delete_text: Services that use this connection can no longer read their code or get push events.
org.name: Name
org.general_text: The name of the organization and the default domain for new services.
org.domain_suffix_hint: New services get a host under this domain. Example: apps.example.com.
org.require_2fa: Require two-factor login for every member
org.require_2fa_hint: Members without 2FA must set it up at the next sign-in.
org.acme_email_hint: Let's Encrypt sends expiry notices to this address.
org.danger_text: The organization is deleted at once and all data is purged after 30 days. This cannot be undone from the panel.
org.delete_text: All projects, services, secrets and backups of this organization will be removed.
shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.intro: Single-key shortcuts are off while you type in a field. No shortcut runs a destructive action.
shortcuts.focus_search: Focus the search or filter box
shortcuts.go: Go to Dashboard, Projects, Nodes, Alerts, Logs, the service list, Deployments
shortcuts.close: Close a dialog, sheet or the palette
shortcuts.setting_text: Turn off keys such as g, d, r and t. Ctrl K and ? always work.
deploykey.title: Deploy key and webhook
deploykey.text: Make an SSH key for a private repository, and the webhook for push events. A new key replaces the old one.
deploykey.failed: The deploy key was not created.
deploykey.once: The public key, the webhook URL and the secret are shown only once. Copy them now.
statusbar.label: Status bar
statusbar.calm_os: Calm mode is on because your system asks for less motion.
promptline.label: Command line
windowbar.label: Windows
shortcuts.vim_action: Move the cursor row, open it, first row, last row
profile.calm_text: Turns off all motion and all effects. No information is lost.
profile.fx_calm: Effects are off in Calm mode.
language.label: Language
